Max–norm    Estimates

The finite element approximation is essentially defined by a mean-square
        projection of the gradient. Thus, it is natural that error estimates for the
        gradient of the error directly follow in the L2 norm. It is interesting to ask
        whether such a gradient-projection would also be of optimal order in some
        other norm, for example L∞. We prove here that this is the case. Although
        of interest in their own right, such estimates are also crucial in establishing
        the viability of approximations of nonlinear problems (Douglas & Dupont
        1975) as we indicate in Sect. 8.7. Throughout this chapter, we assume that
        the domain Ω ⊂ IRd is bounded and polyhedral.
